claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Loop-completion representation lists explicitly leave integer hypercharge alpha free. First T1-i row has scalar1_alpha, scalar2_(alpha-1), fermion1_alpha, scalar2_(alpha+1), in source Q=T3+Y/2 units. It is a symbolic family, not four known integer-normalized numerical charges. T4-1-i is divergent correction to typeII; T4-1-ii finite loop sector cannot forbid associated tree contribution by the stated charge relations.

source_descriptions.reason: A fixed alpha, mediator copy counts and complete independent fermion/reality data are not specified by a topology row; no numeric-subset charge normalization is performed.
